President's Address

135 of 166 sentences in this record
Mdm Halimah Yacob
Engagement, economy, wages, infrastructure progress

Singapore deepened engagement, advocated free trade, saw steady growth and real wage rises, and opened transport and housing projects.

  2. s00007 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacobcontext

    We deepened our engagement with neighbours, as well as major global powers.

  3. s00008 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

    We advocated for free trade against rising protectionism and helped to conclude the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership.

  5. s00010 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

    The economy recorded steady growth, especially in 2017, which we hope will extend into 2018.

  6. s00011 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

    Real wages rose steadily for all income groups.

  8. s00013 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacobcontext

    The Government, industries and unions are partnering one another to implement the recommendations of the Committee on the Future Economy.

  9. s00014 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

    We opened Changi Terminal 4, launched 46,000 new Build-To-Order (BTO) units, completed the addition of 1,000 more buses and opened new Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) lines.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    Education and social safety nets

    Education was strengthened at all levels and social safety nets enhanced, with support from KidSTART to Silver Support.

    1. s00018 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacobcontext

      We strengthened education at all levels – from preschool for toddlers to lifelong learning opportunities for all ages.

    2. s00019 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      We enhanced social safety nets and provided more support for the vulnerable – from KidSTART for at-risk young children to Silver Support for seniors who had earned low incomes.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    National Gallery and multiracial Constitution

    The National Gallery opened with a Nanyang style exhibition, and the Constitution was amended to reflect multiracial values.

    1. s00022 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacobcontext

      The National Gallery opened to the public, including a permanent exhibition of the unique Nanyang style of painting.

    2. s00023 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      We amended the Constitution to reflect our multiracial values, by ensuring that all ethnic groups have a chance to be represented in the highest office in the land.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    Tackling inequality before it entrenches

    The passage warns that inequality, especially children's differing starting points, must be tackled before it becomes entrenched.

    1. s00049 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacobcontext

      If the same happens to us, our politics will turn vicious, our society will fracture and our nation will wither.

    2. s00050 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      We must tackle inequality, particularly the increasingly dissimilar starting points of children from different family backgrounds, before the problem becomes entrenched in our society.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    Fourth-generation leadership taking shape

    The fourth-generation leadership team is taking shape and more responsibilities, and will uphold foundational values.

    1. s00058 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      In the meantime, the fourth-generation leadership team is taking shape, and taking on more responsibilities.

    2. s00059 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      They will have to confront the question, "What is next for Singapore?" Like their predecessors, the fourth-generation leaders will uphold our foundational values – multiracialism, meritocracy, incorruptibility, self-reliance, inclusivity and openness to the world.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    Fourth-generation leaders and nation-building

    The fourth-generation leaders will work with fellow Singaporeans on the next phase of nation-building.

    1. s00066 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      The fourth-generation leaders will work with fellow Singaporeans to undertake the next phase of nation-building.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    Relations with US and China

    It states that good relations will be pursued with both the US and China.

    1. s00079 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      In particular, we will work for good relations with both the US and China.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    Collaboration with China

    It states continued collaboration with China, including participating in the Belt and Road Initiative.

    1. s00084 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacobcontext

      Through China's four decades of reform and opening up, generations of leaders in both countries have worked closely together.

    2. s00085 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      We will continue to collaborate with China in its next phase of development, including participating in the Belt and Road Initiative.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    Air base and port moves

    It states that moving Paya Lebar Air Base and the city ports will free land and double the Central Business District.

    1. s00099 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      When Paya Lebar Air Base moves to Changi, it will free up an area larger than Ang Mo Kio for redevelopment.

    2. s00100 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      Moving the city ports to Tuas will double the size of the Central Business District.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    SkillsFuture and Adapt and Grow

    It states SkillsFuture will anchor lifelong learning and Adapt and Grow will match workers to jobs.

    1. s00115 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      SkillsFuture will anchor this national culture of lifelong learning for skills mastery.

    2. s00116 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      Adapt and Grow will match workers to jobs and help them stay employable as industries and jobs change.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    Elderly infrastructure and healthcare

    It states elderly-friendly infrastructure will be enhanced and healthcare kept affordable through subsidies and schemes.

    1. s00129 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacobcontext

      We will enhance elderly-friendly infrastructure, including new housing options, and healthcare and fitness facilities.

    2. s00130 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      We will keep healthcare affordable through well-designed healthcare subsidies, MediShield Life, MediFund and enhancements to ElderShield.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    Singapore Bicentennial 2019

    It states the 2019 Singapore Bicentennial will be an occasion to trace roots and draw inspiration.

    1. s00142 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      The Singapore Bicentennial in 2019 – 200 years after Stamford Raffles landed in Singapore – will be an occasion to trace our roots and draw inspiration for the journey ahead.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    Fourth-generation leadership and young Singaporeans

    The fourth-generation leadership must mobilise young Singaporeans' spirit and energy, grow with the people, embrace diverse views, and forge unity of purpose and action.

    1. s00153 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      The fourth-generation leadership must fire up and mobilise the spirit and energy of young Singaporeans.

    2. s00154 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      They must grow with the people they represent; embrace a diversity of views and ideas; and yet forge a clarity of purpose and unity of action.

    • Mdm Halimah Yacob
    Leaders, people and trust

    Leaders must stand firm on principles, listen to people, lead on difficult policies, and each generation must forge trust afresh through shared trials.

    1. s00157 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacobcontext

      There will be moments of truth, when they have to stand firm on principles and ideals while seeking practical resolutions.

    2. s00158 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      They will need to listen to the views and feelings of the people and, by their words and deeds, show that they have heard; yet never fear to lead and mobilise public opinion to support difficult policies in the long-term interest of Singapore.

    4. s00160 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      The trust between the people and their leaders is not automatically passed on from one generation to the next.

    5. s00161 · president-address-2Mdm Halimah Yacob

      In each generation, the people and leaders must work with one another, go through trials and tribulations together, and forge their own bonds afresh.

      To ensure just outcomes and fair procedures in the criminal justice system, we amended the Criminal Procedure Code and the Evidence Act in 2018.

    1. s00023 · 11Mr K Shanmugamcontext

    As 2018 ADMM and ADMM-Plus Chairman, Singapore aims to enhance counter-terrorism cooperation, improve response to chemical, biological and radiological threats, and develop confidence-building measures.

    1. s00033 · president-address-3Dr Ng Eng Hen

      As the Chairman of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and ADMM-Plus in 2018, we aim to: (a) enhance regional counter-terrorism cooperation; (b) improve the region’s capability to respond to chemical, biological and radiological threats from terrorist groups and rogue actors; and (c) develop practical confidence-building measures and codes for unplanned encounters in the aviation and maritime domains, to reduce the risk of miscalculation and de-escalate tensions in the region.

    1. s00039 · president-address-3Dr Ng Eng Hen

    3. s00041 · president-address-3Dr Ng Eng Hen

    Hybrid warfare and social compact
